templates.content:
# CI/CD checklist

- [ ] Build succeeds from a clean checkout
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Secrets come from the CI secret store
- [ ] Artifacts are versioned
- [ ] Rollback step is documented
- [ ] Offline dependencies are cached
